message.content:
Below is a quick‑look at the **Canadian federal holidays that create a “long weekend”** (i.e., the holiday falls on a Friday or a Monday, giving you a 3‑day weekend).  
I’ve also included the *observed* dates for holidays that fall on a weekend (Canada Day and Remembrance Day) so you can see the full weekend span.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Observed (if weekend) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-----------------------|-------------------|
| Family Day (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | 2023‑02‑20 | Monday | – | 2023‑02‑18 – 2023‑02‑20 |
| Good Friday | 2023‑04‑07 | Friday | – | 2023‑04‑07 – 2023‑04‑09 |
| Victoria Day | 2023‑05‑22 | Monday | – | 2023‑05‑20 – 2023‑05‑22 |
| Canada Day | 2023‑07‑01 | Saturday | Observed 2023‑07‑03 (Monday) | 2023‑07‑02 – 2023‑07‑03 |
| Labour Day | 2023‑09‑04 | Monday | – | 2023‑09‑02 – 2023‑09‑04 |
| Thanksgiving | 2023‑10‑09 | Monday | – | 2023‑10‑07 – 2023‑10‑09 |
| Christmas Day | 2023‑12‑25 | Monday | – | 2023‑12‑23 – 2023‑12‑25 |

> **Quick note:**  
> • **Remembrance Day** falls on Saturday, 2023‑11‑11. It’s a statutory holiday, but the *observed* day is Monday, 2023‑11‑13. If you’re counting only the statutory holiday itself, it doesn’t create a long weekend.  
> • Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador). Those are not listed here because they’re not federal holidays.

---

### How to pull this data programmatically

If you’d like to fetch the same information directly from an API (so you can keep your app up‑to‑date automatically), you can use the free **Nager.Date** public‑holiday API:

```bash
GET https://date.nager.at/api/v2/PublicHolidays/2023/CA
```

The response is a JSON array of all Canadian holidays for 2023.  
You can then filter for holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday (or check the `observed` field for weekend holidays) to identify long weekends.

---

  },
